correctness.rationale: Every binary rank-at-most-four fooling-set matrix admits M=UV^T with u_i,v_i in F_2^4 and u_i dot v_i=1. There are exactly (2^4-1)2^3=120 admissible ordered types. Pairwise fooling compatibility is exactly an edge of the associated graph; repetitions are impossible, so the matrix optimum is its clique number. An independent exact Python reconstruction generated all 120 types, 5040 compatible edges, and used a valid greedy-color branch-and-bound proof to obtain maximum clique 11 (12096 visited branch nodes). Independent elimination confirmed the displayed 11-by-11 witness has rank four, all diagonal ones, and never has both opposite off-diagonal entries nonzero. Consequently the global maximum is exactly 11.
residual_risks: The computational upper bound is exhaustive finite branch-and-bound rather than a symbolic classification; it does not determine other fields or ranks.
